# NEW 2026-11-18 round 6, shared main-line lock; 2026-11-19 round 7 F1, the main-line scheduler. Generated by gen_mainline_lock.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# The file name keeps this hook after oe_civil_war_1352.txt and before oe_cof_court_stories.txt (gen_mainline_lock.py).
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_ml_pulse } }
oe_ml_pulse = {
    # v6.5 P2: a civil-war rebel state keeps the tag BYZ (vanilla guards its own tag checks the same way). Without
    # the guard every line also ran on the rebels each month: r17 logged the union line setting itself up again at
    # the start of all 7 civil wars.
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
    # Decision 232 item 2: the lines are written for the 1337 start. At another start date the scheduler stays off.
    effect = {
        oe_ml_mark_start = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes } oe_ml_monthly = yes }
    }
}
# The mark is also set at game start, before any pulse (a save from before the mark gets it from the pulse above).
on_game_start = { on_actions = { oe_ml_start_mark } }
oe_ml_start_mark = {
    effect = { oe_ml_mark_start = yes }
}
